facts.fact: The Mouvement populaire group in the House of Representatives tabled a private member's bill regulating AI use that bars AI on social media from spreading false news, abusive speech or fabricated images and videos, bans unacceptable-risk systems from the market, and sets fines of MAD 50,000-500,000 and prison of 6 months to 5 years.
facts.system: Proposed law on regulating the use of artificial intelligence

MAR.note: The document is a draft AI law and states no government body using an AI system.

facts.fact: The Mouvement populaire group tabled in the House of Representatives a private member's bill regulating AI use across sectors, with risk tiers, a national AI committee under the head of government and penalties, in force from publication in the Official Gazette.
facts.system: Proposed law on regulating the use of artificial intelligence

MAR.note: The bill sets rules for AI in medicine and education but states no AI tool in service or under way in a public sector system.
The document is a draft AI law and states no AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country.
The bill only requires AI systems to comply with Law 08-09 and states nothing on its standing, authority, regulations or application.
The bill would require AI systems to follow international technical standards such as ISO and IEEE, but states no membership, national adoption or public-body mandate.
